intro: The Gift of Skysight is an early rite of passage for young Windshapers learning to harness their innate connection to the spiritual realm. Under the direction of Ventaari Brightwish, initiates travel to an Elemental Convergence to awaken their perception and listen directly to the whispers of the spirits.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The gift of skysight will provide you a powerful boon. Use it wisely.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Like a muscle, your skysight must be exercised if you hope to grow stronger in the gift. Leveraging your skysight to bridge the distance between the mortal and the spiritual may prove invaluable to you in your adventures.
You'd do well to remember what you've learned here today. Our ability to use our gifts to hear what the elements tell us could be the key to our survival.
